title: MatchMiner-AI: Open-source, Privacy-preserving Cancer Clinical Trial Matching using Artificial Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2412.17228v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Background: Clinical trials are essential to advancing cancer treatments, but fewer than 10% of adults with cancer enroll in therapeutic trials. Open-source AI trial matching tools could democratize access to trial options. Methods: We created MatchMiner-AI, co-developed with practicing clinical oncologists and trained on synthetic electronic health record (EHR) data. It uses open-weight LLMs to summarize patient histories from unstructured EHR text and extract target populations from trial eligibility documents. Embedding and re-ranking models were distilled to retrieve and rank trial and patient suggestions. Multifaceted evaluation was performed, including retrospective quantification of distillation fidelity; applying a closed-source LLM as judge of patient summarization and matching; and evaluation of candidate matches by oncologists. translated_title: MatchMiner-AI：基于人工智能的开源、隐私保护的癌症临床试验匹配系统
translated_abstract: 摘要：临床试验对于推进癌症治疗至关重要，但只有不到10%的成年癌症患者参与治疗性试验。开源AI试验匹配工具可以促进试验选择的普及。方法：我们创建了MatchMiner-AI，与临床肿瘤学家共同开发，并在合成电子健康记录（EHR）数据上进行训练。它使用开放权重大语言模型（LLMs）从非结构化EHR文本中总结患者病史，并从试验资格文件中提取目标人群。通过蒸馏嵌入和重排序模型来检索和排序试验及患者建议。进行了多方面的评估，包括对蒸馏保真度的回顾性量化；使用闭源LLM作为患者总结和匹配的评判者；以及由肿瘤学家对候选匹配进行评估。结果：在蒸馏保真度的回顾性评估中，该流程表现优于……
tldr: 本文介绍MatchMiner-AI，一个利用开放权重LLM和蒸馏嵌入模型、在合成数据上训练的开源隐私保护工具，旨在提升癌症临床试验匹配的可及性和效率。
en_tdlr: This paper presents MatchMiner-AI, an open-source privacy-preserving tool that uses open-weight LLMs and distilled embedding models trained on synthetic data to improve accessibility and efficiency of cancer clinical trial matching.
